title: SearchAgentInputSpec
description: The structured task spec the worker writes for the bounded career-search-agent (agent_service._search_input_spec). The agent reads this file instead of relying on a long prompt: it carries the already-created session_id, the workspace that session lives in, the search budget, and the fixed output path. Built by the worker, consumed by the career-search-turn-operator skill.

session_id.description: Session the worker already created. The agent MUST NOT start/end it.

workspace_id.description: Workspace the session lives in; pass to every wrapper via --workspace-id so writes land in the right workspace.

search_brief.description: Free-text objective for this discovery run.

max_queries.description: Hard query budget for the session.

max_pages.description: Hard fetch-page budget for the session.

coverage_draft.description: Absolute path the agent must write coverage_draft.md to; the gateway judges completion by its existence.
